remarks: Unbeatable price for the newest section (completed in 2013) of sought-after Riverstone complex-. 3-level townhouse with 2 full bthrs, 2 half bthrs and 2 bdrs as well as an ADDITIONAL spacious room could satisfy the most demanding buyers. Both the deck and patio are overlooking a river. Very private setting. 9ft ceilings, gourmet white kitchen with marble countertops, end of the line appliances, crowned moldings, huge pantry and custom closets. One small dog might be allowed. Dog acceptance is completely at the discretion of the landlords. This townhouse has it all and will not last.
